supplements: J-STAGE article presents no separate data supplement. Thompson deposit AM-08-006 is CIF structural data; the complete relevant EOS observation table and ambient structure are printed in the article. Original EOS fit inputs, code and calibrant readings were not supplied.
structure_selection: Thompson observed ambient structure used; adjacent ideal geometric models not used. Raudsepp synthetic D0/Ni0 rejected as a pure structural reference because refined M2 is Ca0.89Mg0.11. Cameron/Levien natural near-endmember structures reviewed as alternatives, not substituted into EOS parameters.
